note: Foraging by the heir (roadmap item 44; core/game/game_forage.gd, checked by tools/check_data.gd). The Forage action gathers the nearest node (a tree, herb patch, bone pile or outcrop with a material, as GameWorldGen places them) within `reach` tiles of the heir that has not been gathered within the companions' `regrow_years`, takes its amount times the heir's class share (`classes`, `default` otherwise) into the family's stores and marks it gathered (GameDynasty.gathered, the same marks the companions use), so a node the heir has taken is not gathered again by a companion and the other way round. The time it takes is the world clock's, not the action's. No dice are drawn and the autopilot never forages.

text.nothing: There is nothing here to gather.
text.upstairs: There is nothing to gather up here.
